sources.title: Netflix Q3 revenue up 12%; non-English viewing grows
Netflix Inc. Form 8-K (Letter to Shareholders dated Oct. 20, 2026)

scenes.title: Netflix keeps 35¢ per $1
scenes.sub: Here's how a streaming app got that profitable.
scenes.sub_html: Here's how a streaming app got that profitable.

lines.say: Netflix keeps about thirty five cents of every dollar it brings in, as operating profit.
lines.show: Netflix keeps about 35¢ of every dollar it brings in, as operating profit.

lines.say: That's huge for a company that spends heavily on shows. Here's how.
lines.show: That's huge for a company that spends heavily on shows. Here's how.

scenes.label: in 3 months
scenes.note: Up about 12% from a year earlier

lines.say: Last quarter, Netflix brought in twelve point eight seven billion dollars, up about twelve percent.
lines.show: Last quarter, Netflix brought in $12.87 billion, up about 12%.

lines.say: After paying for shows, marketing and tech, it kept thirty four point six percent. That's its operating margin.
lines.show: After paying for shows, marketing and tech, it kept 34.6%. That's its operating margin.

scenes.label: expected in 2026
scenes.note: Cut from about $3B. Roughly 5% of sales.

lines.say: Ads are growing, but small. Netflix now expects about two point seven billion this year.
lines.show: Ads are growing, but small. Netflix now expects about $2.7 billion this year.

lines.say: That's roughly five percent of the fifty one billion in sales it expects.
lines.show: That's roughly 5% of the $51 billion in sales it expects.

lines.say: Members pay every month, and a show costs the same to make whether ten million or a hundred million people watch.
lines.show: Members pay every month, and a show costs the same to make whether 10 million or 100 million people watch.

lines.say: So more viewers spread that cost thinner.
lines.show: So more viewers spread that cost thinner.

scenes.takeaway: Make it once. Sell it to millions.
scenes.source: Data: Netflix Q3 2026 results, via TheDesk and Advanced Television
